name: Monk of the Empty Hand
summary: An improvisational combatant proficient only with shuriken who turns ordinary objects and even conventional weapons into improvised extensions of unarmed skill.

featureOverrides.summary: Gain a Monk bonus feat, adding Improved Dirty Trick, Improved Steal, and Improvised Weapon Mastery to the 6th-level list.
Gain the normal ki pool and may spend 1 ki to increase an improvised thrown weapon or shuriken's range increment by 20 feet for 1 round.

features.name: Improvised Flurry
features.summary: Flurry only with unarmed strikes, shuriken, or improvised weapons; normal weapons are treated as equivalent improvised weapons and only shuriken proficiency is retained.

features.name: Versatile Improvisation
features.summary: As a swift action, change an improvised weapon's damage type to bludgeoning, piercing, or slashing for 1 round.

features.name: Ki Weapons
features.summary: Spend ki to use unarmed strike damage with an improvised weapon; from 11th level, spend ki to add enhancement bonuses or weapon abilities.
features.scaling: up to 3 ki at 11th; up to 5 ki at 15th

features.name: Greater Ki Weapons
features.summary: Grant improvised weapons enhancement bonuses or weapon abilities, even when the weapon could not normally receive them.
